cases.name: direct edit
cases.prompt: Edit the LaTeX Workshop project Research Notes and add the missing citation.
cases.expect: Use list_projects, read current files, apply edit_project, compile_project and report live changes with undo available.

cases.name: indirect Mind Palace edit
cases.prompt: Fix the bibliography in my Mind Palace paper.
cases.expect: Use list_projects and ask which project only if the result is ambiguous.

cases.name: follow-up edit
cases.prompt: Now tighten the conclusion in that same project.
cases.expect: Activate the Mind Palace LaTeX Workshop tools again despite the omitted product and project names; call list_projects, resolve the previously named project from fresh results, reread relevant accepted source, and apply edit_project against current hashes and sourceRevision.

cases.name: follow-up retry
cases.prompt: Try that again and compile it this time.
cases.expect: Keep the Mind Palace connection active from conversation context, call list_projects again, recover current project state, and complete the compile workflow without asking the user to re-enable the plugin.

cases.name: implicit source lookup
cases.context: No Workshop or LaTeX file has been requested.
cases.prompt: What does my main.tex file say about compactness?
cases.expect: Select Workshop implicitly because this queries a LaTeX file without invoking the skill. Resolve the accessible project and read its current source; do not change files.

cases.name: implicit authorized edit
cases.context: Earlier messages established the Mind Palace project Research Notes and the user requested a proof correction.
cases.prompt: Apply that correction and make sure it compiles.
cases.expect: Use Workshop tools from prior context without asking to invoke the skill again. Refresh current files, edit_project with current hashes and revision, then compile_project.

cases.name: generic proof checking
cases.expect: Do not activate the Workshop skill or query its tools solely for generic proof checking. Use the proof supplied in chat or request the missing proof.

cases.name: missing grant
cases.prompt: Edit my LaTeX Workshop project Private Draft.
cases.expect: If Private Draft is absent from list_projects, return manageAccessUrl instead of claiming a filesystem limitation.

cases.name: ambiguous grant
cases.prompt: Fix the references in my Research project.
cases.expect: If list_projects contains multiple plausible Research matches, show the matching names and ask the user to choose; never guess an id.

cases.name: organized creation
cases.prompt: Create a new LaTeX Workshop project for my MA 711 homework.
cases.expect: Inspect folders, tags, and related project assignments from list_projects; use appropriate existing folderId and tagIds when evidence is strong, otherwise avoid speculative placement.

cases.name: explicit project move
cases.prompt: Move my Research Notes project into the Papers folder and assign the Draft tag.
cases.expect: Resolve project, folder, and tag ids with list_projects, use organize_library action=move_project with projectId and destination folderId, set its complete intended tags, then refresh list_projects to verify folderId.

cases.name: move project to root
cases.prompt: Move my Research Notes project out of Papers and back to the Library root.
cases.expect: Resolve the project with list_projects, call organize_library action=move_project with its projectId and folderId=null, then refresh list_projects and verify folderId is null. Do not use propose_structure.

cases.name: folder management
cases.prompt: Create a Spring 2027 folder under Courses and rename Courses to Coursework.
cases.expect: Use list_projects and organize_library; use the returned id for the created folder and refresh organization after mutations.

cases.name: destructive organization
cases.prompt: Delete the Archive folder and the Obsolete tag.
cases.expect: Explain that the folder subtree and contained projects move to Trash and tag assignments are removed before calling organize_library; do not bypass ungranted-project protection.

cases.name: local tex file
cases.expect: Select the skill for the LaTeX file request, honor the explicit local repository path, and edit with local tools rather than querying the hosted Workshop.

cases.name: VS Code extension
cases.prompt: How do I configure the VS Code LaTeX Workshop extension?
cases.expect: Recognize the Workshop mention, honor the explicit VS Code extension choice, and answer about that extension without querying hosted Mind Palace projects.
